subject.title: Feature: Support custom anthropic_beta flags in Bedrock model config

question: Should Bedrock expose a broad `additionalModelRequestFields`/`providerFields` merge contract, a narrower typed `anthropicBeta` or `context1m` option, or no custom beta config surface?
rationale: The missing capability is source-proven, but the fix adds or declines a public provider config/request-body contract and AGENTS.md sets a high bar for new config surfaces and provider request shaping.

options.title: Add a Bedrock request-field merge contract
options.body: Expose a schema-validated Bedrock-owned merge point for vendor request fields and document precedence plus `anthropic_beta` dedup semantics.

options.title: Add only a typed beta option
options.body: Support a narrow `anthropicBeta` or `context1m` option for Anthropic Bedrock while avoiding arbitrary request-body passthrough.

options.title: Keep beta flags internal
options.body: Decline custom beta config and require users to wait for first-class Bedrock provider support when vendor beta fields change.

recommendation.title: Add a Bedrock request-field merge contract
recommendation.body: Expose a schema-validated Bedrock-owned merge point for vendor request fields and document precedence plus `anthropic_beta` dedup semantics.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Bedrock runtime/options history makes this the closest observed owner for request-shaping and config-contract direction.
